notes: Controller emits a ControllerEvent stream (clear/teardown/validated/opened/metadata/rejected); OpenWorkspace renders exclusively from it, so offers through ANY caller surface identically — this is what makes the size/page-count limits observable in the DOM without mocks.
'clear' records the retired generation; 'teardown' records the new generation — the strict inequality is the I07 proof point asserted in tests.
PageSelection refuses over-cap mutations ('limit') and reports truncated in its summary — the 'no silent exclusion' mechanism is refusal-plus-notice, never quiet trimming.

Region numeric input is validated, not clamped; pointer drags are clamped to the raster surface by construction; both paths produce contract Region records in canonical_page space with the page's raw_to_canonical transform id.
